specification.description: Classic gold mini tote in faux leather with a neat standard silhouette, suited to casual spring styling.
construction_details: Lightly structured faux leather panels with clean topstitching
Twin carry handles with reinforced base tabs
Open top with an internal magnetic snap closure
specification.care_instructions: Wipe with a soft, dry or lightly damp cloth; store stuffed in a cool, dry place and avoid contact with oils or solvents.

quality_adjustments: Synthetic capacity defined as 70% of external volume, rounded down to 0.1 L, to correct impossible generated volume.
